notes.title: Global fix update
notes.notes:
Global update, including bug fixes and improvement of the "quality of life" of the player.

List of changes:

[olist]
[*] Added tooltips for interface elements and map objects.
[*] Added "hot keys" and scrolling of lists with the mouse wheel.
[*] Added information about the unit in all windows.
[*] Added the ability to remove units from the army.
[*] The resource panel is now displayed in all windows where it is required.
[*] Improved the contrast of interface elements with the background.
[*] Added indication of enemy heroes.
[*] Added display of the army of a hero or monster when right-clicking on it.
[*] Added windowed mode.
[*] The sound setting can now be minimized.
[*] Improved AI.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes, instead of winning a mission, a defeat was counted.
[*] Fixed a bug with the inability to specify the target for some spells.
[*] Fixed a bug with sometimes not closing tutorial windows.
[*] Fixed a bug with freezing on the course of the enemy in battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where when moving to another hero, units disappeared from the army
[*] Fixed a bug with the game freezing when the "bomb" ability is triggered.
[*] Fixed a bug with sometimes overlapping music tracks.
[/olist]

notes.title: Battle bonuses
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39833628/d9b5a83e9edd7f4dc973bbc14b8c5777599321e6.png[/img]

Battle bonuses system has been added to the game. At the beginning of battle in the central part of the field, several bonuses are generated that increase the damage or health of the unit. To activate bonus, unit must be moved on the appropriate hex. Bonuses effect is cumulative and persists until the end of the battle.
Now it is beneficial to immediately move forward, and not wait for the enemy in your position. The role of rifle units has also decreased - they ceased to be imba.

In addition, the following fixes have been made:
* Added support for windowed mode.
* Added scrolling of lists with the mouse wheel.
* The sound settings panel now opens and disappears at the click of a button.
* You can now skip a unit's turn in battle.
* Now, at the beginning of the game, each hero, in addition to the basic units, has one random "advanced" unit of his native race.

notes.title: Fixed scaling of the interface.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39833628/b911d3937c0e40ca04f07b78f94448c6fc201a4b.png[/img]

Fixed an issue resulting in many users being unable to play properly.
The game interface is now displayed in normal scale on monitors of any size and resolution.

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39833628/599072d9bc6e19e8a38277198c3abb720fe05603.png[/img]
A new version of the game 1.05 is available. The following edits have been made:
[list]
[*] Increased interface elements in the main menu and lobby. As well as the learning window and the font size in it.
[*] Increased the contrast of the text and background of buttons for better readability.
[*] Added display of information about the selected unit on the army screen.
[*] Fixed a bug with the loss of a unit when transferring it from one hero to another.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which sometimes two music tracks started simultaneously.
[*] Balance edits.
[/list]

Previous update 1.04:
[list]
[*] Added hotkeys for movement (WSAD), hero selection (1, 2, 3) and main interface buttons.
[*] Added pop-up windows with tips for the main interface buttons on the global map.
[*] Misclicks have been eliminated.
[*] Added information windows on the unit collection screen, containing description and characteristics.
[*] Now, at the beginning of each turn, the hero who moved the last time is automatically selected, you do not need to select him manually every time.
[*] Added a resource panel in the research and recruitment windows to make it clear whether there are enough resources or not.
[/list]
